title: Rectitude Holdings Ltd Secures Additional AIMS System Orders for Major Infrastructure and Residential Projects Across Singapore
summary: Rectitude secures additional orders to supply its SuperSun AIMS solution to multiple marquee developments across Singapore. The procurement wins include a multi-site blanket order for high-profile public housing, private residential, and healthcare infrastructure projects. The Company expands its market footprint through a dedicated project engagement for a luxury residential development in collaboration with Tanglin Corporation […]
